glosses: of which (referring to the whole clause).

examples.text: Wovon hast du ein Bild gemacht?
examples.en: What did you take a picture of?
He knows what he's talking about.

examples.text: Ich weiß nicht, wovon du redest.
examples.en: I don't know what you're talking about.

examples.text: Du weißt genau, wovon ich rede.
examples.en: You know exactly what I'm talking about.
